text:
Anya: Hey front desk — I have a guest arriving ~3pm with a stroller and a small package (scented candles). Can someone pre-print a temp badge and reserve a sofa? Need a safe spot for the stroller. 🙏
Front Desk: Hi Anya! We can hold the package and print a temp badge. Do you want us to put the package in a locker or keep it behind the desk?
Anya: Locker would be great, ideally #4 if it's free. Also please add a 'FRAGILE' sticker to the box — candles.
Facilities: Locker #4 currently has a phone charger in it. I can move that to lost & found, or we can use #7 or the small shelf by concierge.
Priya: I can clear charger out of #4 in ~10 mins. @Front Desk please label the package fragile when it arrives.
Front Desk: Thanks Priya — we'll move the charger to lost & found and put the package into locker #4. Badge printing ETA 2:50pm.
PackageBot: Package delivered: 1x “Lumiere Candles” for Anya. Courier: Airship (tracking 1Z999). Stored in locker #4.
Jordan: FYI the stroller can be parked in the bike room (aisle C) if you want it out of the lobby footprint.
Anya: Bike room aisle C works — thanks @Jordan. Do we need a dolly/cart to move it or is it light?
Sam: I can meet at 2:45pm to help move the stroller and pick up the badge if that helps.
Anya: Absolute legend, thank you! Quick tiny poll: should we leave the sofa reserved for the guest? :thumbsup: yes | :thumbsdown: no
Priya: :thumbsup: — short visit, let's keep it.
Front Desk: Badge printed (black lanyard): "Anya - Guest". Package labeled: "FRAGILE — candles" and placed in locker #4. We'll DM a photo of the badge to you instead of posting here.
Anya: Perfect — please DM when ready. Appreciate everyone jumping on this. :sparkles:
